message.content:
## RETAKEN Audit — SLOT PICKER (390px)

### 1) Slot pill tap comfort
✅ **Fixed.** Pills now render at ~44px height with consistent grid rhythm and adequate horizontal gaps. Visual touch target law met.

### 2) Available vs taken/past readability
❌ **Still broken — this is the core defect.** Every slot from 09:00 to 16:45 renders identically: same faded gray pill, no line-through visible, no contrast between "open" and "taken/past" states. The footer says "32 slots open" but the grid reads as one undifferentiated wall of disabled-looking pills. A user cannot tell which slots they can actually pick. Either:
- the taken/past treatment (line-through + opacity) isn't applying, **or**
- the *available* state has no visual affordance (needs white/1px-border or outlined pills vs faded taken ones).

Either way the state model is not distinguishable — the exact failure from the first audit, still unresolved.

### 3) Date chips + confirm bar rhythm
✅ Mostly fine. "11/24" active chip (black) has clear emphasis; "Tomorrow" faded as unavailable is acceptable. Confirm bar is disabled-gray with no selection — correct behavior. Minor: no visible *selected-slot* state exists anywhere in the grid, so the confirm bar can never plausibly enable within this screen as rendered.

### 4) Remaining defects
- No selected-slot visual state in the grid (tied to #2).
- Disabled confirm gives no hint why (no "select a time" helper text) — minor.

---

## Verdict: **FAIL**

Fix before re-audit: render available slots with a distinct style (e.g. white bg + 1px border, or full-opacity text) and keep taken/past pills faded + line-through, so the two states are separable at a glance; add a selected-pill state (black bg, as on the active date chip).
